title: Jade Forest Keeper
limitations: Character motion is procedural, not generated by a trained motion model.
Organic anatomy is procedurally constructed, not generated by a trained 3D model.
A bounded original creature design supports facial proportion changes, not arbitrary sculpting.
Idle performance is procedural; no speech, walking, or learned facial performance.
Geometry and idle performance are procedural, with no trained sculpting model.
This scene uses moonlight lighting for a forest portrait with no extra props.
